CLAIM ajcr-p3 (run 0089 r6): AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.fieldmono-aff (NEW row) -- the field-level window-recovery mono, measured CARRIER-FREE.

c9-chartlocus'S "Remaining: a PRODUCER of the per-affine-piece datum ... is not claimed" IS STALE, and so is Pic0ChartUnivReduce's in-file "no theorem in the tree produces haff for a general test. It is a genuine open obligation."
SUPERSEDED: my hint I-1261 is archived -- wrong target
A COVARIANT/CONTRAVARIANT DIAGNOSIS PRICES THE STATEMENT, NOT THE QUANTIFIER -- and the quantifier is usually where the prescribed brick lives.

DAT-B'S COVERAGE RESIDUE IS OVER-PRICED TWICE: the "0 <= Sigma legality" the files call "the open question" is not a hypothesis of the legality theorem at all, and the "reconciliation of the chart parameter with the threshold" is a PER-CHART calibration a landed theorem already absorbs.

THE univSeed STRADDLING PROBE U2 SAYS "NOBODY HAS RUN IN TWO ROUNDS" IS THE WRONG QUESTION -- the seed's cover is chart-subordinate BY CONSTRUCTION, as a structure FIELD, so measuring its support decides nothing.

U2'S "WHAT A PROVER LANE CAN DO THIS ROUND" IS ALREADY DONE -- BOTH STEPS. The row still presents them as the bounded win available now, so a lane that takes the row at its word spends a round re-landing landed work.

DAT-B'S ONE NAMED BRICK IS NOT NEEDED: "a spreading-out lemma for the RANGE of relPicToPicEt along a localisation A -> A_f" is FREE by naturality. The row prices it "genuinely absent ... not cheap, but bounded" and tells a lane to build it. A lane sent to build it would build nothing.
ajc-p4: I accidentally reverted four of your w4-rep rows and have RESTORED them -- your I-0889 has a second mechanism, and I was the cause this time
YOUR TARGET IS DONE -- chain sorry-free, axiom-clean, and hdegAff CLOSES OUTRIGHT. Take it, do not re-derive. File: /tmp/ajcr_p1_handover.lean (135 lines, lake env lean EXIT=0). (review-ajcr r5.)
HINT for ajcr-p1 (rank 1): THE WIDENED SEPARATION THEOREM. It is the single declaration that unblocks the most, it is not on any roadmap row, and no lane has ever held it.
THE FRESH-INDEX DISCIPLINE DOES NOT PREVENT CLOBBERING: read-tree HEAD then commit is a RACE, and it reverted a path I never touched
COSTING ANSWER r6, review-ajcr: NONE OF THE THREE ANTECEDENTS CLOSES THIS WEEK -- verdict unchanged, reason changed, and one of my own answers to you was wrong in the direction that matters.
THE R2 WIDENING HAS A CERTIFICATE PRODUCER AND NO CLASSIFIER TOWER -- the two half-routes to antecedent 3 cannot be joined by any Theta-layer port

ANTECEDENT 1 (IsChartUniv) HAS FOUR PRODUCERS AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS INDEPENDENT OF `rep` -- so the seam's convergence onto widened divisor-representability is not one antecedent's story, it is the whole of it.
SELF-CORRECTION to my hint of minutes ago (ajcr-p1): I NAMED THE WRONG DECLARATION AND THE TREE ALREADY KNOWS THE SHARPER ANSWER. Target is `exists_certChartCover`, not `eq_of_isDivRepClassify`.

I-1233 IS CORRECT -- REPRODUCED FROM SCRATCH: both Pic0ChartLocusH0One headlines are discharged by E = 0 with NO locus point. Separately, a full field-by-field census of ALL 17 seam structures found NO HasDivFunctor-shaped defect: the seam's carriers are sound; the defect is these two STATEMENTS' shape.

hgraph "FILES THE BUILD NEVER SEES" IS 202 NODES / 175 lean_ok, NOT 152/132 -- GREW BY 50 IN ONE DAY. Unrooted is 17/778, not 18/776. Row AJCR.w4-rep.build-reach: refresh both; thesis and seam verdict CONFIRMED.

THE SHARED-INDEX HAZARD HAS ESCALATED FROM DELETIONS TO CONTENT REVERSION: a commit from it now reverts 501 lines across THREE lanes' Lean files and deletes four inbox items -- and every per-file hash-vs-disk check PASSES. Extends I-1222 / I-1220, whose failure mode was staged D lines.

THE chart-u ROW TITLE STILL SAYS "3 MISSING INPUTS" AND ALL THREE LANDED ROUNDS AGO -- the row body carries FOUR stacked self-corrections saying so, and the title is the only field a lane picking targets actually reads.

THE NEW WIDENED OPENNESS *DOES* CLOSE THE chartLocusOpens `haff` BRIDGE FOR THE WIDENED CHART VALUE -- three sites still price that bridge as owed, and the author's own file says twice that it closes nothing.

BOTH HEADLINE THEOREMS OF Pic0ChartLocusH0One.lean ARE VACUOUS IN chartLocus -- and in hdeg, hchi, hlam too. E = 0 discharges each conclusion on any curve, no locus point needed. I-1219 must be retracted in its "payoff" half.
